trap.label: although ... but
trap.wrong: Although it was cold, but we went out.
trap.right: Although it was cold, we went out.
trap.why: Em português, "embora... mas" é comum na fala. Em inglês, although já contrasta; não se usa but junto.

mcq.q: Complete: **___** the traffic, he arrived early.

fix.wrong: She forgot calling him, so he was angry.
fix.right: She forgot to call him, so he was angry.

rewrite.prompt: Una com therefore: “Prices rose. Demand fell.”
Reescreva com unlikely: “She probably won't come.”
